management_remarks: ICICI Bank delivered strong core operating performance in Q1 FY25 with Net Interest Income expanding robustly and domestic loan growth reaching 15.6% year-on-year. Our Net Interest Margin remained resilient at 4.36% supported by disciplined asset pricing and granular retail and business banking franchise expansion. Asset quality continues to be pristine with Net NPA ratio at 0.43% and Provision Coverage Ratio exceeding 80%, alongside strong digital adoption on iMobile Pay and InstaBIZ.
analyst_qa: In response to analyst questions on deposit competition, we remain cautious as systemic wholesale deposit rates stay volatile and CASA mobilization faces headwinds across the banking sector. We have taken a calibrated approach to unsecured personal loans and credit cards, tightening underwriting filters where bureau leverage appears uncertain. Near-term NIM trajectory is subject to lagged deposit repricing, making aggressive margin expansion challenging in the immediate quarters.
